Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

ipse

ipse, ipsa, ipsum

pronoun

the very, just, exactly

In this lexicon

  • just

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 7.23.4: eā ipsā hōrā (Lewis & Short); Cic. Att. 3.21: trīgintā diēs erant ipsī, it was just thirty days (Lewis & Short)

  • ipse vīderit: business

    classical

Examples

  • ibi mihi Tulliola mea fuit praestō nātālī suō ipsō diē

    there my little Tullia was waiting for me, on her very birthdayCic. Att. 4.1.4

    In the entry for just

  • Salvum tē advenīre, Dēmea, gaudēmus. — Ehem, opportūnē: tē ipsum quaeritō.

    We’re glad to see you safely here, Demea. — Ah, good timing: you’re just the man I’m looking for.Ter. Ad. 80–81

    In the entry for just

  • ōlim mihi nūllās epistulās mittis. nihil est, inquis, quod scrībam. at hoc ipsum scrībe, nihil esse quod scrībās

    you haven’t sent me a letter for ages. ‘There’s nothing to write,’ you say. Then write just that: that there’s nothing to writePlin. Ep. 1.11.1
